Bjørnar is at home, and the phone rings.
sentences.Hei, mamma! Hvordan har du det på tur?: Hi, Mum! How are you getting on with your trip?
sentences.Bare bra, jeg koser meg, men jeg savner: Just fine, I'm having a lovely time, but I miss Bamse. How are you all? Do you remember to take Bamse for a walk every day?
sentences.Vi har det fint alle sammen, og barna el: We're all fine, and the children love taking him for walks. Bamse is the kindest dog in the world. Where are you now?
sentences.Vi har akkurat passert Nordkapp, og i mo: We've just passed the North Cape, and tomorrow we arrive in Kirkenes. It's so wonderful to travel with Hurtigruten. Travelling around Norway is the best thing I know. I've met lots of interesting people and seen some of the most beautiful places in Norway.
sentences.Det kan jeg tenke meg. Har du tatt mange: I can imagine. Have you taken lots of pictures?
sentences.Se på Facebook! Jeg har lagt ut et helt: Look on Facebook! I've posted a whole album with the nicest pictures from the trip.
How nice! We'll look at the pictures tonight. What has the weather been like?
sentences.Været var best den første dagen. Da var: The weather was best on the first day. It was warm and sunny then. In the north-west there was a lot of rain and quite a bit of wind, especially in Molde. The waves were a bit big, but I didn't get seasick. The last few days it's been a bit colder, but the sun shines both at night and during the day, and the waves are smaller now.
sentences.Jeg skal hilse deg fra verdens gladeste: Greetings from the happiest grandchildren in the world. They love Bamse so much. Enjoy the rest of your trip!
sentences.Bjørnars mor er på tur med Hurtigruten f: Bjørnar's mother is on a trip with Hurtigruten from Bergen to Kirkenes.
sentences.Hun ringer og snakker med Bjørnar, for h: She phones and talks to Bjørnar, because she misses Bamse.
sentences.Hun har sett mange flotte steder i Norge: She has seen many beautiful places in Norway and met many interesting people.
sentences.Hun har tatt mange fine bilder, og de fi: She has taken lots of nice pictures, and she has posted the nicest ones on Facebook.
sentences.Det er ca. fire av ti nordmenn som har k: About four out of ten Norwegians have a pet.
sentences.30 prosent av alle nordmenn har hund ell: 30 per cent of all Norwegians have a dog or a cat, and 10 per cent have other pets.
sentences.Det er ca. 300 000 husholdninger som har: There are about 300,000 households with a cat and about 245,000 households with a dog.
sentences.Hurtigruten er store skip som går langs: Hurtigruten is large ships that sail along the coast from Bergen to Kirkenes.
sentences.Tidligere fraktet skipene varer mellom b: In the past the ships carried goods between the towns along the coast.
sentences.Nå frakter Hurtigruten også mange turist: Now Hurtigruten also carries lots of tourists every year.
sentences.Det er populært å reise langs kysten med: It is popular to travel along the coast with Hurtigruten.
The trip takes 11 days there and back.
